description: Turn a Lark/Feishu chat message describing a requirement into a structured Bitable record with an AI-written PRD draft, then reply to the sender with a card.

input.description: Webhook body (what the Lark bot relay posts).

user_text.description: The requirement text as written in chat.

message_id.description: Lark message id to reply to.

sender_open_id.description: Sender's Lark open_id (used to look up their name and fill person fields).

output.description: execute_workflow returns an execution id. On success the workflow has created one Bitable record (fields filled by DeepSeek, PRD text in the PRD field) and replied in the chat.

record_id.description: New Bitable record id (in the Create Bitable Record node output).

sideEffects: Sends a Lark card reply to message_id

body.user_text: Add CSV export to the orders page
